ιαειροσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H2971); Jairus (i.e. Jair), an Israelite. KJV: Jairus.

ιακωβ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3290); Jacob (i.e. Ja`akob), the progenitor of the Israelites. KJV: also an Israelite:--Jacob.

ιακωβοσ.def: the same as Ἰακώβ (G2384) Græcized; Jacobus, the name of three Israelites. KJV: James.

ιαμα.def: from ἰάομαι (G2390); a cure (the effect). KJV: healing.

ιαμβρησ.def: of Egyptian origin; Jambres, an Egyptian. KJV: Jambres.

ιαννα.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare H3238); Janna, an Israelite. KJV: Janna.

ιαννησ.def: of Egyptian origin; Jannes, an Egyptian. KJV: Jannes.

ιαομαι.def: middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to cure (literally or figuratively). KJV: heal, make whole.

ιαρεδ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3382); Jared (i.e. Jered), an antediluvian. KJV: Jared.

ιασισ.def: from ἰάομαι (G2390); curing (the act). KJV: cure, heal(-ing).

ιασπισ.def: probably of foreign origin (see H3471); "jasper", a gem. KJV: jasper.

ιασων.def: future active participle masculine of ἰάομαι (G2390); about to cure; Jason, a Christian. KJV: Jason.

ιατροσ.def: from ἰάομαι (G2390); a physician. KJV: physician.

ιδε.def: second person singular imperative active of εἴδω (G1492); used as an interjection to denote surprise; lo!. KJV: behold, lo, see.

ιδεα.def: from εἴδω (G1492); a sight (comparative figuratively "idea"), i.e. aspect. KJV: countenance.

ιδιοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; pertaining to self, i.e. one's own; by implication, private or separate. KJV: X his acquaintance, when they were alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several), home, (her, our, thine, your) own (business), private(-ly), proper, severally, their (own).

ιδιωτησ.def: from ἴδιος (G2398); a private person, i.e. (by implication) an ignoramus (compare "idiot"). KJV: ignorant, rude, unlearned.

ιδου.def: second person singular imperative middle voice of εἴδω (G1492); used as imperative lo!;. KJV: behold, lo, see.

ιδουμαια.def: of Hebrew origin (H123); Idumæa (i.e. Edom), a region East (and South) of Palestine. KJV: Idumæa.

ιδρωσ.def: a strengthened form of a primary idos (sweat); perspiration. KJV: sweat.

ιεζαβηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H348); Jezabel (i.e. Jezebel), a Tyrian woman (used as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher). KJV: Jezabel.

ιεραπολισ.def: from ἱερός (G2413) and πόλις (G4172); holy city; Hierapolis, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Hierapolis.

ιερατεια.def: from ἱερατεύω (G2407); priestliness, i.e. the sacerdotal function. KJV: office of the priesthood, priest's office.

ιερατευμα.def: from ἱερατεύω (G2407); the priestly fraternity, i.e. sacerdotal order (figuratively). KJV: priesthood.

ιερατευω.def: prolongation from ἱερεύς (G2409); to be a priest, i.e. perform his functions. KJV: execute the priest's office.

ιερεμιασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3414); Hieremias (i.e. Jermijah), an Israelite. KJV: Jeremiah.

ιερευσ.def: from ἱερός (G2413); a priest (literally or figuratively). KJV: (high) priest.

ιεριχω.def: of Hebrew origin (H3405); Jericho, a place in Palestine. KJV: Jericho.

ιερον.def: neuter of ἱερός (G2413); a sacred place, i.e. the entire precincts (whereas ναός (G3485) denotes the central sanctuary itself) of the Temple (at Jerusalem or elsewhere). KJV: temple.

ιεροπρεπησ.def: from ἱερός (G2413) and the same as πρέπω (G4241); reverent. KJV: as becometh holiness.

ιεροσ.def: of uncertain affinity; sacred. KJV: holy.

ιεροσολυμα.def: of Hebrew origin (H3389); Hierosolyma (i.e. Jerushalaim), the capitol of Palestine. KJV: Jerusalem.

ιεροσολυμιτησ.def: from Ἱεροσόλυμα (G2414); a Hierosolymite, i.e. inhabitant of Hierosolyma. KJV: of Jerusalem.

ιεροσυλεω.def: from ἱερόσυλος (G2417); to be a temple-robber (figuratively). KJV: commit sacrilege.

ιεροσυλοσ.def: from ἱερόν (G2411) and συλάω (G4813); a temple-despoiler. KJV: robber of churches.

ιερουργεω.def: from a compound of ἱερόν (G2411) and the base of ἔργον (G2041); to be a temple-worker, i.e. officiate as a priest (figuratively). KJV: minister.

ιερουσαλημ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3389); Hierusalem (i.e. Jerushalem), the capitol of Palestine. KJV: Jerusalem.

ιερωσυνη.def: from ἱερός (G2413); sacredness, i.e. (by implication) the priestly office. KJV: priesthood.

ιεσσαι.def: of Hebrew origin (H3448); Jessæ (i.e. Jishai), an Israelite. KJV: Jesse.

ιεφθαε.def: of Hebrew origin (H3316); Jephthaë (i.e. Jiphtach), an Israelite. KJV: Jephthah.

ιεχονιασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3204); Jechonias (i.e. Jekonjah), an Israelite. KJV: Jechonias.

ιησουσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3091); Jesus (i.e. Jehoshua), the name of our Lord and two (three) other Israelites. KJV: Jesus.

ικανοσ.def: from ἵκω (ἱκάνω or ἱκνέομαι, akin to ἥκω (G2240)) (to arrive); competent (as if coming in season), i.e. ample (in amount) or fit (in character). KJV: able, + content, enough, good, great, large, long (while), many, meet, much, security, sore, sufficient, worthy.

ικανοω.def: from ἱκανός (G2425); to enable, i.e. qualify. KJV: make able (meet).

ικετηρια.def: from a derivative of the base of ἱκανός (G2425) (through the idea of approaching for a favor); intreaty. KJV: supplication.

ικμασ.def: of uncertain affinity; dampness. KJV: moisture.

ικονιον.def: perhaps from εἰκών (G1504); image-like; Iconium, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Iconium.

ιλαροσ.def: from the same as ἵλεως (G2436); propitious or merry ("hilarious"), i.e. prompt or willing. KJV: cheerful.

ιλασκομαι.def: middle voice from the same as ἵλεως (G2436); to conciliate, i.e. (transitively) to atone for (sin), or (intransitively) be propitious. KJV: be merciful, make reconciliation for.

ιλασμοσ.def: atonement, i.e. (concretely) an expiator. KJV: propitiation.

ιλαστηριον.def: neuter of a derivative of ἱλάσκομαι (G2433); an expiatory (place or thing), i.e. (concretely) an atoning victim, or (specially) the lid of the Ark (in the Temple). KJV: mercyseat, propitiation.

ιλεωσ.def: perhaps from the alternate form of αἱρέομαι (G138); cheerful (as attractive), i.e. propitious; adverbially (by Hebraism) God be gracious!, i.e. (in averting some calamity) far be it. KJV: be it far, merciful.

ιλλυρικον.def: neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation; (the) Illyrican (shore), i.e. (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of Europe. KJV: Illyricum.

ιμασ.def: perhaps from the same as ἅμα (G260); a strap, i.e. (specially) the tie (of a sandal) or the lash (of a scourge). KJV: latchet, thong.

ιματιζω.def: from ἱμάτιον (G2440); to dress. KJV: clothe.

ιματιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of ennumi (to put on); a dress (inner or outer). KJV: apparel, cloke, clothes, garment, raiment, robe, vesture.

ιματισμοσ.def: from ἱματίζω (G2439); clothing. KJV: apparel (X -led), array, raiment, vesture.

ιμειρομαι.def: middle voice from ἵμερος (a yearning; of uncertain affinity); to long for. KJV: be affectionately desirous.

ινα.def: probably from the same as the former part of ἑαυτοῦ (G1438) (through the demonstrative idea; compare ὁ (G3588)); in order that (denoting the purpose or the result). KJV: albeit, because, to the intent (that), lest, so as, (so) that, (for) to.

ιναμη.def: i.e. ἵνα (G2443) and μή (G3361); in order (or so) that not. KJV: albeit not, lest, that, no(-t, (-thing)).

ινατι.def: from ἵνα (G2443) and τίς (G5101); for what reason ?, i.e. why?. KJV: wherefore, why.

ιοππη.def: of Hebrew origin (H3305); Joppe (i.e. Japho), a place in Palestine. KJV: Joppa.

ιορδανησ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3383); the Jordanes (i.e. Jarden), a river of Palestine. KJV: Jordan.

ιοσ.def: perhaps from εἶμι (to go) or ἵημι (to send); rust (as if emitted by metals); also venom (as emitted by serpents). KJV: poison, rust.

ιουδα.def: of Hebrew origin (H3063 or perhaps H3194); Judah (i.e. Jehudah or Juttah), a part of (or place in) Palestine. KJV: Judah.

ιουδαια.def: feminine of Ἰουδαῖος (G2453) (with γῆ (G1093) implied); the Judæan land (i.e. Judæa), a region of Palestine. KJV: Judæa.

ιουδαιζω.def: from Ἰουδαῖος (G2453); to become a Judæan, i.e. "Judaize". KJV: live as the Jews.

ιουδαικοσ.def: from Ἰουδαῖος (G2453); Judaïc, i.e. resembling a Judæan. KJV: Jewish.

ιουδαικωσ.def: adverb from Ἰουδαϊκός (G2451); Judaïcally or in a manner resembling a Judæan. KJV: as do the Jews.

ιουδαιοσ.def: from Ἰουδά (G2448) (in the sense of Ἰούδας (G2455) as a country); Judæan, i.e. belonging to Jehudah. KJV: Jew(-ess), of Judæa.

ιουδαισμοσ.def: from Ἰουδαΐζω (G2450); "Judaism", i.e. the Jewish faith and usages. KJV: Jews' religion.

ιουδασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3063); Judas (i.e. Jehudah), the name of ten Israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its region. KJV: Juda(-h, -s); Jude.

ιουλια.def: feminine of the same as Ἰούλιος (G2457); Julia, a Christian woman. KJV: Julia.

ιουλιοσ.def: of Latin origin; Julius, a centurion. KJV: Julius.

ιουνιασ.def: of Latin origin; Junias, a Christian. KJV: Junias.

ιουστοσ.def: of Latin origin ("just"); Justus, the name of three Christian. KJV: Justus.

ιππευσ.def: from ἵππος (G2462); an equestrian, i.e. member of a cavalry corps. KJV: horseman.

ιππικον.def: neuter of a derivative of ἵππος (G2462); the cavalry force. KJV: horse(-men).

ιπποσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a horse. KJV: horse.

ιρισ.def: perhaps from ἐρέω (G2046) (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities); a rainbow ("iris"). KJV: rainbow.

ισαακ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3327); Isaac (i.e. Jitschak), the son of Abraham. KJV: Isaac.

ισαγγελοσ.def: from ἴσος (G2470) and ἄγγελος (G32); like an angel, i.e. angelic. KJV: equal unto the angels.

ισαχαρ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3485); Isachar (i.e. Jissaskar), a son of Jacob (figuratively, his descendant). KJV: Issachar.

ισημι.def: assumed by some as the base of certain irregular forms of εἴδω (G1492); to know. KJV: know.

ισθι.def: second person imperative present of εἰμί (G1510); be thou. KJV: + agree, be, X give thyself wholly to.

ισκαριωτησ.def: of Hebrew origin (probably H377 and H7149); inhabitant of Kerioth; Iscariotes (i.e. Keriothite), an epithet of Judas the traitor. KJV: Iscariot.

ισοσ.def: probably from εἴδω (G1492) (through the idea of seeming); similar (in amount and kind). KJV: + agree, as much, equal, like.

ισοτησ.def: likeness (in condition or proportion); by implication, equity. KJV: equal(-ity).

ισοτιμοσ.def: from ἴσος (G2470) and τιμή (G5092); of equal value or honor. KJV: like precious.

ισοψυχοσ.def: from ἴσος (G2470) and ψυχή (G5590); of similar spirit. KJV: likeminded.

ισραηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3478); Israel (i.e. Jisrael), the adopted name of Jacob, including his descendants (literally or figuratively). KJV: Israel.

ισραηλιτησ.def: from Ἰσραήλ (G2474); an "Israelite", i.e. descendant of Israel (literally or figuratively). KJV: Israelite.

ιστημι.def: a prolonged form of a primary στάω (of the same meaning, and used for it in certain tenses); to stand (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively). KJV: abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish, hold up, lay, present, set (up), stanch, stand (by, forth, still, up).

ιστορεω.def: from a derivative of εἴδω (G1492); to be knowing (learned), i.e. (by implication) to visit for information (interview). KJV: see.

ισχυροσ.def: from ἰσχύς (G2479); forcible (literally or figuratively). KJV: boisterous, mighty(-ier), powerful, strong(-er, man), valiant.

ισχυσ.def: from a derivative of ἰς (force; compare ἔσχον, a form of ἔχω (G2192)); forcefulness (literally or figuratively). KJV: ability, might(-ily), power, strength.

ισχυω.def: from ἰσχύς (G2479); to have (or exercise) force (literally or figuratively). KJV: be able, avail, can do(-not), could, be good, might, prevail, be of strength, be whole, + much work.

ισωσ.def: adverb from ἴσος (G2470); likely, i.e. perhaps. KJV: it may be.

ιταλια.def: probably of foreign origin; Italia, a region of Europe. KJV: Italy.

ιταλικοσ.def: from Ἰταλία (G2482); Italic, i.e. belonging to Italia. KJV: Italian.

ιτουραια.def: of Hebrew origin (H3195); Ituræa (i.e. Jetur), a region of Palestine. KJV: Ituræa.

ιχθυδιον.def: diminutive from ἰχθύς (G2486); a petty fish. KJV: little (small) fish.

ιχθυσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a fish. KJV: fish.

ιχνοσ.def: from ἰκνέομαι (to arrive; compare ἥκω (G2240)); a track (figuratively). KJV: step.

ιωαθαμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3147); Joatham (i.e. Jotham), an Israelite. KJV: Joatham.

ιωαννα.def: feminine of the same as Ἰωάννης (G2491); Joanna, a Christian. KJV: Joanna.

ιωαννασ.def: a form of Ἰωάννης (G2491); Joannas, an Israelite. KJV: Joannas.

ιωαννησ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3110); Joannes (i.e. Jochanan), the name of four Israelites. KJV: John.

ιωβ.def: of Hebrew origin (H347); Job (i.e. Ijob), a patriarch. KJV: Job.

ιωηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3100); Joel, an Israelite. KJV: Joel.

ιωναν.def: probably for Ἰωάννης (G2491) or Ἰωνᾶς (G2495); Jonan, an Israelite. KJV: Jonan.

ιωνασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3124); Jonas (i.e. Jonah), the name of two Israelites. KJV: Jonas.

ιωραμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3141); Joram, an Israelite. KJV: Joram.

ιωρειμ.def: perhaps for Ἰωράμ (G2496); Jorim, an Israelite. KJV: Jorim.

ιωσαφατ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3092); Josaphat (i.e. Jehoshaphat), an Israelite. KJV: Josaphat.

ιωση.def: genitive case of Ἰωσῆς (G2500); Jose, an Israelite. KJV: Jose.

ιωσησ.def: perhaps for Ἰωσήφ (G2501); Joses, the name of two Israelites. KJV: Joses.

ιωσηφ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3130); Joseph, the name of seven Israelites. KJV: Joseph.

ιωσιασ.def: of Hebrew origin (H2977); Josias (i.e. Joshiah), an Israelite. KJV: Josias.

ιωτα.def: of Hebrew origin (the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet); "iota", the name of the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, put (figuratively) for a very small part of anything. KJV: jot.
